_comment: The full boxes' measured speeds (tools/make_full_configs.py --import-speed; never edited by hand): smoke: smoke A's verdict check 3 (median steady s/step per student at the full configs' batches); box1: box 1's measurement from tools/box1_go.py --json at the runs-repo revision of its 4-epoch record (null until box 1 ended: the hours are then provisional). make_full_configs.box_hours projects the HOURS_BOXES' train items' max_hours and their est_hours / max_hours from it, and --check holds boxes.json to them.
